scope: Two further reviews focused on stock BusyBox capability, router identity limits, space and transfer cleanup

pass_one.finding: All 50 supported official release default BusyBox configurations disable stat and its custom format feature; old directory metadata command therefore required a non-default applet
pass_one.fix: Shared directory metadata module probes optional formatted stat once, otherwise reads stock ls numeric ownership and symbolic permission bits; no package installation or default permission guesses
pass_one.directory_mtime_limit: Without stat only directory modification time is set to epoch zero; actual modes, uid/gid and special mode bits are retained. File timestamps remain in captured tar headers

native.scope: Native x86-64 BusyBox ls-only build and production shell command in isolated temporary directories; not a full router firmware

focus: SSH receive/send flow control and exit status
Same-device identity comparison and address mutability
added_regressions: Transient send timeout followed by successful partial sends
Cancellation during receive closes channel and streams
Remote early exit cannot acknowledge incomplete upload
Truncated or hash-mismatched download is rejected
Remote stderr is bounded and resources close
Missing or insufficient free-space data prevents continuation
pass_two.identity_limit: Network addresses can be changed by software and are not cryptographic immutable device identifiers. Current matching is a same-device heuristic under the user-owned same-router scope; no claim of tamper-proof identity

validation.syntax_encoding_whitespace: Changed Python files compiled; UTF-8 and whitespace checks clean

limits: Debian tests bypass capture_services package initializer due to missing PySide6 and do not validate the desktop UI
BusyBox native validation uses an isolated x86-64 ls-only build with relevant stock OpenWrt flags, not a complete firmware or device
Earlier APK and opkg native install proofs were not repeated because package encoding and install commands did not change
Deleted initialization scripts and non-reconstructable extended permissions still stop incomplete backups
